jobs.title: Quantitative Developer
jobs.description:
QCP is Asia's leading digital asset partner, empowering clients to seamlessly integrate digital assets into their portfolios.

We offer a comprehensive range of solutions - from spot on/off ramping and fixed income strategies to vanilla options and bespoke exotics.

Driven by the vision to be the most trusted partner in digital asset markets, we provide innovative solutions that make digital assets a core component of every portfolio, balance sheet, and treasury.

Since our founding in 2017, we have witnessed the potential of digital assets to transform financial markets and the world at large. We exist at the centre of change, successfully navigating three market cycles and bridging institutional and crypto ecosystems.

We work to build trusted partnerships, putting client success and care at the heart of everything that we do.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain components of our trading systems and supporting infrastructure, across execution and order management, exchange connectivity, market data, pricing and risk, and backtesting
* Work alongside traders, quants and portfolio managers to understand what they need and build it
* Write high-quality, maintainable, and efficient code, and learn from thorough code review
* Develop and debug software in a Linux environment
* Help investigate and resolve production issues, with support from the wider team
* Make good use of modern tooling, AI coding agents, and development practices
* Collaborate with team members in a fast-paced environment with daily deployments
* Take on additional engineering tasks as required by the team

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or Financial Engineering, graduating soon or with up to two years of experience
* Strong programming ability in at least one of Java, Python, C# or Rust; we are open to candidates from any language background who can pick things up quickly
* Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms
* A working grasp of threading models and concurrency
* Evidence that you can build things and finish them, whether through internships, open-source contributions, coursework or your own projects
* Genuine enthusiasm for agentic development and working alongside AI coding agents
* An interest in trading and financial markets, however it has come about
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, fast-moving environment

  
**Benefits**

The Environment We Offer

As a growing firm with a tightly-knit team, we respect and listen to all our employees. You will get the chance to make an impact by having your voice heard by everyone, including the management.

Our employees enjoy a high level of autonomy at work. We focus on substance, not form - as long as you can perform, you will be recognized and rewarded. We are also dedicated to supporting our staff and ensuring they develop holistically to maximize their potential in the long- term.

We also provide flexible working arrangement as required and a casual and fun environment to boot!

jobs.title: Manager (Engineering), Digital Innovation Studio
jobs.description:
Institution: Tan Tock Seng Hospital

Family Group: Administration

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

  

**Job Title:**

Manager (Engineering), Digital Innovation Studio

**NHG Vision: Adding years of healthy life**

  

**CHI Mission: Driving innovation for systems change**

  

The Centre for Healthcare Innovation (CHI) is committed to catalysing and driving innovation for systems change in healthcare, thereby adding years of healthy life. Built on the foundation of co-learning and collaboration, CHI’s core is in facilitating innovation through its suite of platforms and programmes. CHI has built a dynamic network of local and international partners who are dedicated to fostering innovation, creating thought leadership, co-building initiatives to inculcate and embed a culture of innovation within healthcare. We spearhead innovation by driving the adoption of the CHI Innovation Cycle, care and process redesign and in the use of technology. CHI leads transformation at the care, systems and ecosystem levels to achieve better health and healthcare.

  

**About the Digital Innovation Office (DIO)**

  

The Digital Innovation Office (DIO) under the Centre for Healthcare Innovation (CHI) drives NHG Health’s digital transformation across three key platforms: Digital Hospital, Digital Community, and Health Empowered by AI Launchpad (HEAL).

DIO’s mission is to enable transformation and deliver impact by supporting institution-led platforms that advance workforce and care transformation. Through collaborative programmes and partnerships, DIO serves as a catalyst for AI adoption at scale and digital innovation across hospitals and community care.

**JOB SUMMARY**

  

Reporting to the Assistant Director, Digital Innovation Studio (DIS), the role will manage DIS’s proof-of-concept (POC) platforms consisting of multi-cloud sandbox environments and maintain full technical understanding of their AI and/or IT standards. The candidate will undertake important technical activities together with NHG project teams for the robust prototyping of digital solutions that support CHI’s digital and AI-enabled future.

  

In addition, the candidate will participate in user-engaged product iteration, and technology ecosystem stewardship—working closely with clinicians, operations teams, UX specialists, data scientists, and industry partners.

**MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

1. **Technical Prototype Engineering**

* Design and support the development of lightweight prototypes, including front-end interfaces, back-end services, and workflow components.
* Collaborate with project teams to define technical requirements and translate business needs into implementable solution designs, ensuring alignment with security and scalability considerations.
* Develop technical documentation such as PRDs that include human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflow and guardrail/safety mechanisms, and architecture diagrams.
* Provide hands-on support for prototype development, testing, and technical troubleshooting.

**2. Sandbox Platform Management**
----------------------------------

* Maintain DIS multi-cloud sandbox environments across AWS, Azure and/or GCP, including user onboarding, resource provisioning, and access management .
* Manage and optimise additional enterprise prototyping platforms, ensuring users can effectively build solutions using pre-established services and reusable architecture patterns.
* Engage industry cloud providers and healthcare IT vendors to stay abreast of emerging platforms, integration approaches, and capabilities, and advise project teams on designing prototypes aligned with target deployment environments.
  

**3. Administrative support**

* Support DIS in secretariat or administrative work where needed.
* Design and deliver hands-on training workshops on modern software development practices and the effective use of cloud-based tools and platforms.
  

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

  

(A) EDUCATION, TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
* 5 years hands-on engineering experience (front-end or back-end in cloud environment).
* Ability to build and iterate prototypes using both traditional development stacks (e.g. JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, .NET) and low-code/no-code tools within enterprise security constraints.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS preferred), containerized deployments, and enterprise integration patterns.

* Proficient in drafting PRDs and creating pragmatic lightweight solution architectures to guide technical implementation
  

**Desired Skills**

* Passion for healthcare and to create new solutions that can benefit patients or hospital systems.
* Experience working in healthcare, or with standards such as HL7/FHIR, is advantageous.
* Understanding of cybersecurity principles, data protection, and safe experimentation in enterprise settings.
* Experience working with vendors or external tech partners is a bonus.
* Flexible mindset to adopt new platforms and create new technical frameworks or processes in our evolving environment

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Keywords Studios, established in Dublin in 1998, now has 70+ studios across Europe, North and South America and Asia with 12,000+ employee strength located across 5 continents and 26 countries. The company provides complete outsourced game art, engineering, testing, audio and localization service for all Console, PC, Handheld and Mobile content, to many of the biggest names in games and interactive entertainment, working on thousands of titles including many of the best-selling titles of the past few years.

Keywords Studios is comprised of many individual brands, all with something unique to offer our clients. The studios are integrated into the Group by Service Line and use the operating systems and tools deployed by those services lines to ensure people and projects can operate across studios and across geographies.

Keywords Studios Asia is currently hiring for Singapore based Software Engineers.

 **Requirements**

We are looking for enthusiastic and self-motivated Software Engineers to join our Singapore-based team, working on an exciting, new, and unannounced AAA project.

This is a generalist engineering role with a strong focus on providing front-line technical support to developers. You will investigate development issues, help unblock teams, apply corrective measures where appropriate, and ensure problems are directed to the relevant system owners when deeper investigation is required.

We are hiring across mid and senior levels, with responsibilities calibrated based on experience.

**Responsibilities:**

* Investigate technical issues reported by developers and perform initial analysis to identify the likely cause.
* Apply corrective measures where appropriate, including fixing or rolling back broken compilation or build issues.
* Provide operational guidance to developers to help unblock their work, for example directing them to a stable or usable build.
* Escalate and route issues or JIRAs to the appropriate system owners when further specialist investigation is required.
* Work closely with engineers, designers, artists, and other disciplines to support development and maintain a high-quality product.
* Test, debug, and refine systems and features throughout the development cycle.
* Estimate own tasks and deliver high-quality code according to agreed schedules.
* Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and development standards.

**Requirements:**

* Professional software engineering experience in games or related real-time interactive development.
* Strong proficiency in C++ and C# knowledge.
* Good familiarity with large C++ game codebases.
* Experience working with Perforce or similar source-control systems.
* Experience with commercial game engines such as Unreal Engine and/or Unity.
* Strong debugging, investigation, and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable analysing unfamiliar technical issues and helping developers find practical ways to continue working.
* Comfortable working with distributed teams across different locations and collaborating clearly across disciplines.
* Experience contributing to at least one shipped game in a professional capacity.

**Nice to have:**

* Previous experience in a generalist engineering, developer support, build support, or firefighting role.
* Knowledge of industry-standard development practices including source control, asset pipelines, issue tracking, external QA, and localisation.
* Experience with continuous integration and build automation.
* Exposure to post-launch product development and delivery.
* Experience working in an Agile development environment.
* Experience with art packages and pipeline development.
* Experience with low-level optimisation, shader programming, physics, or mathematics.

  
**Benefits**

*Our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) Commitment: Keywords Studios is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, ethnicity, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. If you require any adjustments during the process please let us know in your application. We are committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation. We especially welcome applications from candidates of underrepresented groups in the industry.*

***PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION POLICY***

*By providing your information in this application, you understand that we will collect and process your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information, please see our Applicant Privacy Notice at* *https://www.keywordsstudios.com/en/applicant-privacy-notice**.*

jobs.title: CSE Engineer Project
jobs.description:
KONE moves two billion people every day. As a global leader in the elevator and escalator industry, we employ over 60,000 driven professionals in more than 60 countries worldwide joined together by a shared purpose, to shape the future of cities. In 2025, we had annual net sales of EUR 11.2 billion.

  
  

KONE has consistently been featured on Forbes list of World's Best Innovative Companies, World's Best Employers & World's Largest Public Companies. At KONE, we believe in teamwork and a work culture where everyone can be who they are. This is exactly what makes us strong and successful.

  

**Why this role?**

A CSE Engineer Project is involved in the most demanding projects. He/she takes over from the CSE Engineer, Solution in the initial start-up meeting, and is accountable for coordination of all engineering work until the project is handed over to maintenance

  

**What will you be doing?**

Solution planning – costing

* Responsible for supplying correct costings in change orders (variations and addworks), both for corporate and local materials

* Involves the Supply Line, installation, maintenance and project management to understand both the materials and service cost of the change orders (variations and addworks)

  

Solution planning – Specs

* Coordinates specification creation for changes

* Accountable for the technical content of the order between MS 0b and MS 2z

* Accountable for final technical site surveys

  

Solution planning – Availability and lead times

Solution planning – Installability

* Ensures that the proposed solution can be installed after the changes are applied

* Ensures that the cost and work effort impact of the installation is part of change costing

* Ensures that the proposed changes fulfils the customer’s product lifecycle needs

* Identifies possible deviations of changes to standard maintenance methods and ensures that a resolution is found

  
  

Solution planning – Compliance

* Ensures that the proposed solution fulfils local codes, regulations and safety requirements

* Ensure alignment with environmental regulations

* Ensures that the planned solution complies with KONE’s Engineering Policy

* Takes over from the CSE Engineer, Solution in the most complex project cases during the initial start-up meeting

  

Key tasks in the KONE Delivery process

CSE Engineer, Project role in the KONE SER process

General responsibilities

* Participates in product and new service release information-sharing sessions

* Offers input to the product offering management about customization, standardization and interface requirements for the portfolio

* Contributes to the Customer Solutions Engineering virtual and local network

* Contributes to and utilizes the Customer Solutions Engineering case library

  
  

**Are you the one?**

  

* Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or another relevant field, or several years’ experience in elevator business field operations

* Understanding of new construction and building modernizations processes in the industry and at KONE

* Good skills in understanding and translating customer needs into KONE technical specifications

* Good knowledge of KONE solution-related norms and standards

* Good knowledge of environmental and sustainability requirements and norms

* Good engineering tool skills e.g. CAD and BIM skills

* Good knowledge of KONE current solutions

* Knowledge of supply engineering. Good understanding on KONE supply operations

* Understanding of KONE quality management

**What’s On Offer**

* Total reward elements that engage and motivate our employees and help us make KONE a great place to work

* Comprehensive learning and development programs covering a wide range of professional skills

* You are surrounded by fun colleagues and a lively working environment. The best part is all leaders are great and open-minded

In the meantime, feel free to browse our website for additional information on our company, brands and culture – KONE Corporation.

jobs.title: Salesforce Developer
jobs.description:
**Location:**  
Singapore
  
  
**Contract:**  
1-Year Contract
  
  
Job Description
  
  
We are seeking for a Salesforce Developer to design, develop, integrate, and enhance Salesforce solutions, with a strong focus on Service Cloud on behalf of our client. The successful candidate will work closely with clients, business stakeholders, and technical teams to deliver scalable and high-quality Salesforce implementations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Develop and customize Salesforce solutions using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce Flows.
  
  
Support and enhance Salesforce Service Cloud implementations.
  
  
Design and implement integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, and integration platforms.
  
  
Perform data migration, transformation, and validation using tools such as Data Loader and ETL platforms.
  
  
Configure and maintain Salesforce security, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, and access controls.
  
  
Develop reports, dashboards, and analytics to support business and operational requirements.
  
  
Collaborate directly with clients, business users, and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  
  
Provide solution consulting and pre-sales support, including technical discussions, solution design, and client presentations where required.
  
  
Follow Salesforce engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, code quality, observability, documentation, and knowledge transfer.
  
  
Troubleshoot production issues and provide ongoing technical support and enhancements.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Hands-on experience as a Salesforce Developer, with substantial experience in Salesforce Service Cloud implementations.
  
  
Salesforce Platform Developer certification or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
Strong development experience with Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Flows.
  
  
Proven experience with Salesforce integrations, including REST/SOAP APIs and middleware.
  
  
Strong understanding of data migration processes and tools, including Data Loader and/or ETL tools.
  
  
Good knowledge of Salesforce administration and security configuration.
  
  
Experience developing Salesforce reports and dashboards.
  
  
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working directly with clients and business users.
  
  
Experience supporting pre-sales, solution consulting, or technical solution design is highly desirable.
  
  
Familiarity with CI/CD, automated testing, observability, documentation, and engineering best practices for large-scale Salesforce implementations.
  
  
Nice to Have
  
  
Experience with Salesforce OmniStudio and OmniScript.
  
  
Experience working on large-scale or enterprise Salesforce transformation projects.
  
  
Additional Salesforce certifications.
  
  
Experience with Salesforce DevOps and deployment tools.
  
  
Base Camp Digital, founded in Singapore in 2018 (formerly Ploy Asia), is a leading IT Solutions and Delivery company operating across Asia, with offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Thailand.
  
  
We provide targeted expertise for successful project outcomes tailored to modern technological demands.
  
  
**Our core delivery expertise focuses on high-growth areas:**  
**Enterprise Software Implementation:** Delivery and support for major ERP/CRM systems, including deep platform expertise in:
  
  
SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Workday, Pega, Microsoft, and ServiceNow.
  
  
**Bespoke Software Development:** Custom application development using key technologies like Java, .NET, and open-source stacks. Inluding Software Testing Manual and Automation.
  
  
**Data, Analytics, and AI:** Services spanning Data Engineering, Data Analysis, and advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions (Machine Learning, Computer Vision, LLMs).
  
  
**Infrastructure Services:** Full-range support, from basic desktop to complex Data Centre management.
